description.en: A blue-haired desktop companion with a whale tail.
description.zh: 摇着鲸尾的蓝发桌面伙伴。

notice.en: ZipZipPipe and 上善无形 are credited for upstream materials; 鹿鹿's new work is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 where licensable, and this unofficial fan theme is unaffiliated with and neither authorised nor endorsed by DeepSeek.

description.en: A full-featured Doraemon desktop companion with cursor-following eyes, roaming, gadget idle animations, multi-session work states, a full sleep cycle and click/drag reactions.
description.zh: 功能齐全的机器猫桌面伙伴：眼球跟随光标、自由漫游、道具待机动画、多会话工作状态、完整睡眠周期与点击/拖拽反应。

notice.en: Doraemon and related names belong to their respective rights holders (Fujiko F. Fujio / Fujiko-Pro, Shogakukan). New artwork and animation by RyanChenJJH are licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 where licensable; this is an unofficial, non-commercial fan work with no affiliation, authorisation or endorsement.
notice.zh: 哆啦A梦（机器猫）角色及相关名称归藤子·F·不二雄／藤子プロ、小学馆等权利方所有；RyanChenJJH 的新作美术与动画在有权授权范围内采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。本主题是非官方、非商业同人作品，与上述权利方无关联，也未获其授权或背书。

description.en: Clawd acts out everyday developer life: thinking, coding, compacting context and errors each get their own little scene. Includes light and dark color schemes, following the system appearance by default.
description.zh: Clawd 演出开发者的日常：思考、写码、压缩上下文、报错都有对应的小剧场。内含浅色、深色两套配色，默认跟随系统。

notice.en: The Clawd character belongs to Anthropic; the drawing code is adapted from Qisi3344/clawd-moji. alwinecor's artwork is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 where licensable, and this unofficial fan theme is unaffiliated with and not endorsed by Anthropic.
notice.zh: Clawd 角色归 Anthropic 所有，绘图代码改编自 Qisi3344/clawd-moji；alwinecor 的美术在有权授权范围内采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0。本主题是非官方粉丝作品，与 Anthropic 无关联，也未获其背书。

description.en: Clawd with more personality: little idle moments, a dreamy sleep and work animations that get more chaotic as more agents run.
description.zh: 更有个性的 Clawd：待机时有各种小片段，睡觉会做梦，同时运行的 agent 越多，工作动画越热闹。

notice.en: The Clawd character belongs to Anthropic. New animations by Allan Oliveira Miraballes are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 where licensable; the original Clawd art comes from Clawd on Desk and is not relicensed; the Fluent Emoji palette and brush are by Microsoft (MIT). This unofficial, non-commercial fan theme is unaffiliated with and not endorsed by Anthropic.
